@description.description:
Describe a symbol.
JSDoc lists `@desc` as a synonym; this inserts the primary form.
https://jsdoc.app/tags-description

@example.description:
Provide an example of how to use a symbol.
https://jsdoc.app/tags-example

@deprecated.description:
Mark a symbol as no longer supported.
https://jsdoc.app/tags-deprecated

@see.description:
Refer to another symbol or resource. Accepts a namepath, an inline `{@link}` or free text.
https://jsdoc.app/tags-see

@link.description:
Inline tag: link to another symbol or a URL. Delete the second placeholder to use the target as the text.
https://jsdoc.app/tags-inline-link

@since.description:
The version a symbol was introduced in.
https://jsdoc.app/tags-since

@version.description:
The version of the documented symbol.
https://jsdoc.app/tags-version

@todo.description:
Work still to be done.
https://jsdoc.app/tags-todo

@ignore.description:
Omit the symbol from the generated documentation.
https://jsdoc.app/tags-ignore

@access.description:
Access level of a symbol. `@public` / `@protected` / `@private` / `@package` are equivalent shorthands.
https://jsdoc.app/tags-access
